title: Quote by Thomas Aquinas: 'Better to illuminate than merely to shine, to deliver to others...'
summary_full: Thomas Aquinas championed the notion of disseminating wisdom for the greater good of society. He drew a distinction between individual brilliance and the act of enlightening others. This thirteenth-century principle is still highly relevant in contemporary leadership practices, stressing the importance of making intricate knowledge understandable for all. True expertise is demonstrated through the ability to clarify ideas and enhance collective understanding.
